quick_facts.sprint_goal: Enrich the product catalog: categories for organization, barcode input on POS for fast lookup, and CSV bulk import so managers can onboard large catalogs quickly.

content.tldr: Three catalog enhancements ship backend+frontend together. Product categories (CRUD), barcode/SKU quick-search on POS, and CSV bulk import for managers.

features_committed.title: Product Categories
features_committed.rationale: Stores with 50+ products need organization. Categories unlock better POS filtering.
tasks: T044: Category entity (id, name, storeId, active) + migration
T046: Product entity: optional categoryId FK
T047: API contract: categories added to wiki/api-contracts/product.json
T049: Product list + POS search: category filter dropdown

features_committed.title: Barcode / SKU Quick-Lookup on POS
features_committed.rationale: Cashiers in real stores use barcode scanners or type SKUs directly. Manual search is too slow.
tasks: T051: POS page: dedicated SKU/barcode input field (auto-focus on page load)
T052: On Enter: GET /products?sku=exact match → add to cart immediately if found
T053: Not-found state: highlight field red + Vietnamese error 'Không tìm thấy sản phẩm'
T054: Input cleared after successful add

features_committed.title: Bulk Product Import (CSV)
features_committed.rationale: Store managers with existing product lists should not have to create 200 products one by one.
tasks: T055: Backend: POST /products/import — multipart/form-data CSV file upload
T056: CSV schema: name, sku, priceVnd, taxRatePercent, categoryName (optional)
T057: Validation: reject row if SKU already exists (return conflict list)
T058: Response: { imported: N, skipped: M, errors: [{row, reason}] }
T059: Frontend: /products/import page — file picker + preview table + submit
T060: Result display: success count + skipped rows with reasons

out_of_scope: Barcode scanner hardware integration (USB/BT HID) — manual SKU entry covers 90% of use cases
prerequisites: Products module + entity stable from Sprint 2

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 7 planned. Full-stack: categories + barcode + bulk import. Backend+frontend together.
